profile.headline: Software Engineer, IoT
profile.summary:
Twenty years experience in IT including Software Architecture, Software Development, Project management and User Experience design.

Specialties: HTML, Javascript, CSS, React, Angular, Python, Django, Flask, PHP, MySQL, Apache, Linux, Unix, AWS Cloud Services, IoT, image processing

positions.title: Layoff/position eliminated
positions.description: After a great 5 years at iRobot, I've been part of the expected reduction in force.  I'm grateful for my time at iRobot and all the amazing people I got to work with.

positions.title: Senior Software Automation Engineer
positions.description: Used React to build single-page web applications supporting reliability testing.  Created and deployed Amazon Cloud Services backend to support these applications using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Aurora RDS, IAM, CloudFormation and Kinesis data pipelines.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Supported Angular single-page web application supporting customer service users.  Created new features including translations, state-store management and user authentication (with OAuth).

positions.title: Sr. Analyst (App Dev)
positions.description: Created internal web applications to automate business processes, including reagent ordering, an API library, and new employee onboarding.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue · Vuex · Flask · SQL · Angular · Image Processing

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Supported users of Harvard's compute cluster with web-based tools including the development of an account creation tool and an instrument scheduling app.
positions.insights: Skills: Django · Python · Bootstrap (Framework) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · MySQL

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description: Supported all aspects of subject testing including web-based psychology games, workstation maintenance, server configuration and data security/privacy.

positions.title: Web Specialist
positions.description: Created web application to support scientific proposal reviews using  Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP development stack.  Front end development with HTML, Javascript, and CSS.  Wrote ImageMagick Bash scripts to dynamically scale/crop and store uploaded images.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · JavaScript · PHP · Apache · Linux · MySQL · Image Processing

positions.title: HTML Coder
positions.description: Wrote HTML and Javascript to support online web zine and promotional materials.
